title: Great little single serve coffee maker!
text: Great little single serve coffee maker!. cute colors and a machine which is easy to use.  You add the amount of water for each serving of coffee you want to make, plop in the kcup and 3 minutes later, you have a hot cup of coffee.  I love it.
